status: Draft. Rankings are Zachary's judgment. Zachary approves every ask. The AI never writes asks or ranks; they come only from this file.

types.name: Late rent and other defaults
types.lookFor: What happens if the tenant pays late or breaks another promise: notice periods, the landlord ending the lease, retaking the space, and what the tenant still owes afterward.
types.why: You can lose the space and still owe money.
asks: More days to pay or fix a problem after the landlord's notice.

types.name: Personal guaranty
types.lookFor: Any promise by the owner or another person to pay the tenant's obligations personally.
types.why: You can owe the business's rent from your own money.
asks: A limit on the guaranty, such as a set number of months of rent.
An end date for the guaranty.

types.name: Subletting and transfer
types.lookFor: Rules for subletting the space or assigning the lease, including the landlord's consent and whether the tenant stays liable.
types.why: You can leave the space and still owe rent for the rest of the lease.
asks: A rule that the landlord cannot refuse consent without a good reason.
Release from the rent once the landlord approves a new tenant.

types.name: Building costs
types.lookFor: Extra rent for the tenant's share of building operating costs, common area charges, or increases over a base year.
types.why: Your total rent can go up, sometimes with no limit.
asks: A yearly limit on how much your share can rise.
Leaving building improvements out of operating costs.

types.name: Property tax increases
types.lookFor: Extra rent for the tenant's share of real estate taxes or tax increases over a base year.
types.why: Your rent can rise when the landlord's taxes rise.
asks: A limit on how much your share of tax increases can rise each year.

types.name: Condition of the space
types.lookFor: Whether the tenant takes the space as is, and who must fix problems that exist at move-in.
types.why: You may have to pay to fix problems that were there before you moved in.
asks: A promise that heating, plumbing, and electrical systems work on move-in day.
